entities.name: Jeffrey H. Schwartz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jeffrey Hugh Schwartz is an American physical anthropologist and professor emeritus of biological anthropology and History and Philosophy of Science at the University of Pittsburgh in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and a fellow and President of the World Academy of Art and Science (WAAS) from 2008 to 2012.
